findings.observation: The adult light-skinned face preserves Halia’s mature long-narrow structure, small bright eyes, fine straight brows, compact upturned nose, heavy lower lip, restrained age planes, shallow cheek scar, and calm closed mouth rather than replacing him with a generic doll face.

The compact figure retains Halia’s exceptional bodybuilder mass through very broad shoulders, deep chest, enormous coherent upper arms and forearms, powerful thighs and calves, and tall-derived upright posture without unrelated fat inflation.
Both upper arms and forearms preserve the source’s exceptional muscular girth; wrists and empty adult hands remain proportionate to that anatomy rather than generic swollen chibi mitts.
The gray-white-silver curls/coils halo preserves the source’s dense rounded front and side silhouette, clustered ringlets, and absence of an added accent.

The terracotta-black lightly quilted long outerwear, high-contrast lining, black fitted layer, low-profile toggles, visible mending, tapered trousers, articulated quilted knees, wraps, work shoes, exactly one geometric forearm tattoo, shallow cheek scar, and stowed wooden comb remain legible with no new accessory or marking.

Original-resolution measurement places the standing figure at roughly y=105–1450 and the complete hair-top-to-chin unit at roughly y=105–510, about 30% of standing height or approximately 3.3 heads tall. This is below the required clear 32–36% / 2.75–3.1-head lock.
Exactly one full-body adult appears with the complete hair halo and head, both empty hands, both shoes, coat tails, and every extremity inside generous parchment margins.
The planted wide stance, compact powerful silhouette, readable empty fists, bright silver halo, and strong terracotta coat shape communicate a grounded weaponless ready-idle figure at combat scale.

The quilted cloth coat, fitted layer, tapered work trousers, wraps, shoes, and stowed comb remain practical mortal equipment; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.
